subject: Collective invoice lane and tax responsibility plan for Order Form
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jan 2028 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Collective invoice lane and tax responsibility plan for Order Form

Liam —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. To keep momentum on the Order Form (ND-4331) and unblock Procurement, we want to propose a simple "collective invoice lane" approach that addresses Nimbus's multi-entity billing and VAT needs while keeping accounting clean on both sides.

Key proposal (high level):
- Redwood issues a single monthly invoice to Nimbus Health US (primary remit entity) for platform usages attributed to the US entity.
- For EU usage (customer facing products billed to EU entity), Redwood will issue a separate invoice to Nimbus Health EU (different remit entity) — this keeps VAT/responsibility localized and avoids reverse-charge ambiguity.
- Net terms: US invoices Net 45; EU invoices Net 60 (we can negotiate).
- Minimum commit phasing: we will split the annual commit into three tranches (50% up-front, 30% Q2, 20% Q4) and invoice per tranche upon commencement.

I attached a draft Order Form (Nimbus_OrderForm_Draft_v3.pdf) with the lane and remit fields annotated. Also included a short tax evidence request template — if you can return a tax certificate for the EU entity that'll speed validation.

Could you confirm whether Nimbus prefers consolidated invoicing to the US entity (and handle internal cross-charge), or strictly per-entity invoicing? If consolidated, we'll include an explicit PO mapping table in the Order Form.

Next step: Kimberly can share the redline-friendly wording for the invoice recipient and tax responsibility clauses; Ben will formalize the minimum commit phasing on the commercial schedule.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Nimbus_OrderForm_Draft_v3.pdf (attachment); tax_request_template.xlsx (attachment)

From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@nimbushealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Collective invoice lane and tax responsibility plan for Order Form

Markus —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from Procurement and Tax: 

1) VAT / reverse charge: For EU services, Nimbus Health EU would prefer Redwood to invoice Nimbus EU directly and show VAT as applicable. If Redwood invoices the US entity we will need to perform an internal cross-charge which creates a month-end recon complexity.

2) Entity mapping & PO: Procurement requires an explicit mapping table in the Order Form (account code -> remit entity -> PO number field). Can your redline include that table?

3) Net terms: US Net 45 is acceptable. For EU we are asking Net 60. We may also request a limited grace window for the first tranche payment while our AP sets up the vendor.

4) Tax evidence attached: tax_certificate_nimbus.pdf (EU entity).

Could Sophie (cc: saas-legal) join if we need to discuss legal language around invoicing and tax allocation (particularly the tax indemnity paragraph).

Thanks,
Liam
Director, Procurement
Nimbus Health

Attachment: tax_certificate_nimbus.pdf (attachment)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jan 2028 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Collective invoice lane and tax responsibility plan for Order Form

Liam —

Thanks for the quick reply and for sending the certificate. Drafting notes below and I've attached a redline-ready doc for Procurement's table.

Proposal (detailed):
- Invoice lanes: add two required fields in the Order Form header: (A) Remit Entity; (B) Invoice Currency; (C) Entity VAT ID. These will be mandatory per-line to support AP mapping.
- VAT handling: clause 4.2 (Taxes) will be updated to say: "Each party is responsible for taxes assessed in its own jurisdiction; where Redwood invoices a non-resident entity, the parties will cooperate to apply reverse charge where permitted; evidence (VAT ID / certificate) must be provided prior to first invoice)."
- Indemnity & evidence: add a limited indemnity cap tied to the invoice amount for errors in remittance data.
- Net terms & milestones: we'll propose Net 45 US / Net 60 EU; first tranche due within 14 days of countersign for the initial 50% (to secure capacity). If Nimbus cannot meet 14 days, we can bump to 30 days for that first tranche only (grace window) — include language for "AP setup" exception.
- Minimum commit phasing table: included in the attached (OrderForm_Invoice_Mapping_Table.xlsx) — this has fields: Tranche, Amount%, Invoice Trigger, Remit Entity, PO Field.

I've attached a redline (redline_nimbus.docx) with the specific insertions. Ben — can you confirm the numeric phasing so I can lock the amounts?

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline_nimbus.docx (attachment); OrderForm_Invoice_Mapping_Table.xlsx (attachment)

From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@nimbushealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Sophie Brooks <sophie.brooks@saas-legal.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jan 2028 14:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Collective invoice lane and tax responsibility plan for Order Form

Kimberly —

Thanks — redline looks straightforward. A few asks before we hand to our Legal & AP: 

- Please add a single-line PO placeholder on every invoice and confirm whether Redwood can accept "PO to follow" on the first invoice while our AP issues a PO. If not, we need a commitment that Redwood will accept a PO post-invoice and link it to the invoice within 5 business days.
- We reviewed the indemnity cap; Sophie flagged that a flat cap tied to the invoice amount is OK, but asks for explicit "good faith" notice period before invocation of indemnity.
- Currency: we prefer USD for US lane and EUR for EU lane. If Redwood invoices in USD for EU lane, we require a clause that exchange-rate differences are Nimbus's responsibility (or we can ask for EUR invoices).

Attached: redline_nimbus.docx (revised by Procurement)

We'll route to Sophie for legal language review and to AP for setup — expect some delay if PO workflow needs change.

Regards,
Liam

Attachment: redline_nimbus.docx (attachment)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Jan 2028 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Collective invoice lane and tax responsibility plan for Order Form

Liam / Sophie —

Appreciate the diligence. Summary and next steps from our side: 

1) PO placeholder: Redwood confirms we can accept "PO to follow" on the initial invoice and will allow AP to submit a PO within 5 business days tied to that invoice. We'll add explicit wording in the Invoicing section.
2) Indemnity: we'll add a "good faith notice" trigger and limit remedy to direct costs up to the value of the affected invoice(s). Legal (Aditya) will draft the exact sentence.
3) Currency: we'll invoice US lane in USD and EU lane in EUR by default. If Nimbus requests single-currency invoicing, we'll add the exchange-rate responsibility clause per your ask.
4) Net terms: propose the following final language: US Net 45; EU Net 60; First tranche for capacity 30 days (grace window) from countersign.

Action owners: 
- Redwood Legal (Aditya Rao) to provide final indemnity wording by EOD tomorrow.
- Kimberly to push a final redline with the PO table and currency fields.
- Ben to confirm numeric phasing and send the final commercial schedule.

If that works, we'll route the final Order Form to DocuSign and provide a short handover doc for your AP to map remit entities.

Thanks everyone —
Markus
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ND-4331
Attachments: redline_nimbus_final.docx (attachment)
